about: The register's banned words and forms, as data for two tests: Register.Prose reads this repository's hand-written documents with it, and Register.Refusals reads every error's message and remedy. It holds the retired vocabulary of V3_INSTRUCTION_ARCHITECTURE.md Appendix A.2, the names round two of the M1 review retired on 2026-09-25, and the two forms that section 10 names from the pull request description's list (A.1): numbered axes and the antithesis tic. A term matches as a whole word or phrase, with or without a plural ending, ignoring case unless it is exact. knowledge/description.md replaces this file at M7.

fields.exact: true when only this spelling is retired: a type in backticks, an identifier, or a v2 module's name
fields.form: a banned form, found by its pattern, a .NET regular expression
fields.unlinted: retired words a lint cannot tell from a live use, each with the reason; review holds them
